name: EIR Technology
name_zh: 四川具身人形机器人科技有限公司
summary:
EIR Technology, operated by Sichuan Embodied Humanoid Robotics Technology, develops humanoid robots for physical interaction and human-facing applications. Its public portfolio includes the full-size Skywalker I and Skywalker II robots, known in Chinese as Tianxingzhe, and AiQ (Aiqiu), a robot focused on emotional interaction.

The company combines complete robot development with an interest in making robots useful companions across different stages of life. Its customer resources include development documentation and robot service support. The distinction between its full-size platforms and interaction-focused product line reflects work on both physical humanoid capabilities and the experience of communicating with people.
